annotations.title: Chilean boleta de honorarios: gross and net

description: Calculate a Chilean fee receipt (boleta de honorarios) from gross to net, or the gross to issue for a target net, with the withholding rate of the year under Ley 21.133: 15.25% in 2026, 16% in 2027 and 17% from 2028. Amounts in whole pesos. Use cl_sueldo_liquido for employees with a contract. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/honorarios via x402.

ano.description: Year of the receipt, from 2023; default current year.

monto.description: Amount in Chilean pesos: the gross, or the net when direccion is liquido-a-bruto.
